svg.title: Fifty simulated confidence intervals for a normal mean
svg.desc: Fifty horizontal intervals from independent samples of size eight, with the true mean drawn as a vertical line and the intervals that fail to cover it drawn in red.
svg.text: Coverage is a property of the recipe, not of any one interval
Each row is one fresh sample of size n = 8 from a normal with mean 10 and standard deviation 0.3.
Intervals drawn in red missed: 3 of the 50 rows here, against the 2.5 misses a 95 percent recipe averages.
Rerun the simulation and a different set of rows turns red. The recipe carries the 95 percent; a single row cannot.
